title: Leakage-Controlled Structure-Preserving Augmentation and Template-Aware Evaluation for Bangla Symptom-Based Disease Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.41733v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bangla symptom-based disease prediction is commonly evaluated on a small, imbalanced structured benchmark containing many profiles that differ by only one or two symptoms. We test whether train-only asymmetric Bernoulli perturbation improves classification using 725 unique profiles spanning 85 diseases and 172 binary symptoms. Experiments use ten repeated real-profile holdouts and parent-grouped inner cross-validation. The 2 x 2 design separates augmentation from hyperparameter tuning, with exact duplication, random oversampling, class weighting, and SMOTEN as balancing controls. For Bernoulli Naive Bayes (BNB), the gain over tuned raw training does not withstand Holm correction, although BNB attains the highest mean accuracy (97.50%). The boosted-tree models benefit substantially: XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost improve by 18.10, 28.45, and 10.09 percentage points, respectively. translated_title: 面向孟加拉语症状疾病预测的泄漏受控结构保持增强与模板感知评估
translated_abstract: 基于孟加拉语症状的疾病预测通常在小型、不平衡的结构化基准上进行评估，该基准中包含许多仅相差一两个症状的档案。我们使用涵盖85种疾病、172个二元症状的725个独特档案，测试仅在训练集上进行的非对称伯努利扰动能否改善分类效果。实验采用十次重复的真实档案留出法以及按父组分组的内部交叉验证。2×2设计将数据增强与超参数调优分离，并以精确复制、随机过采样、类别加权和SMOTEN作为平衡对照方法。对于伯努利朴素贝叶斯（BNB），尽管其取得了最高的平均准确率（97.50%），但其相对于经过调优的原始训练的增益未能通过Holm校正。提升树模型则显著受益：XGBoost、LightGBM和CatBoost分别提升18.10、28.45和10.09个百分点。汉明距离审计显示，标准留出集中有91.0%的档案与训练档案相差不超过两个症状……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出仅在训练集上进行的泄漏受控、保持症状结构的非对称伯努利数据增强方法与模板感知评估框架，显著提升孟加拉语症状疾病预测中提升树模型（XGBoost、LightGBM、CatBoost）的准确率，并揭示标准基准中普遍存在的模板泄漏问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes leakage-controlled, structure-preserving train-only Bernoulli augmentation with template-aware evaluation for Bangla symptom-based disease prediction, substantially improving boosted-tree models (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) while exposing widespread template leakage in the standard benchmark.
